cards.headline:
AMDLSS5 mod brings DLSS 5
to AMD Radeon RX 9000 cards
cards.body: AMDLSS5 runs Nvidia's DLSS 5 on Radeon RX 9000 cards and claims 64% higher fps than other mods in Resident Evil Requiem.

blocks.x: DLSS 5 has been out for a while now, but obviously not for AMD cards — not officially, anyway. Mods have previously got the machine learning-aided neural rendering tech running on AMD RX 9000-series silicon, and now there's a significantly improved one.
AMDLSS5 version 2.0 is now out (via Wccftech). Compared with "other mods", it's claiming +64% fps in Resident Evil Requiem, and +11% fps compared with the previous version of this one.

That's particularly great, if true: PC Gamer's testing of DLSS 5 on an AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT using a different mod managed just 9 fps in Cyberpunk 2077 at 4K on RT Ultra settings, with FSR 4 set to Balanced.
DLSS 5 itself can be very intensive, even on an Nvidia GPU: in NBA 2K27, frame rates dropped up to 73% at 4K on an RTX 5080.

According to the mod's creator on Reddit, supported games include Resident Evil Requiem, Cyberpunk 2077, The Witcher 3 (DX12 remaster only), Red Dead Redemption 2, Shadow of the Tomb Raider, Nioh 3, Final Fantasy XVI, Monster Hunter Wilds, Onimusha: Way of the Sword, PRAGMATA and Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced (story mode, offline only).

Some Reddit comments say the quality isn't very good with the mod enabled. Installation involves downloading the files and running the installer, which "installs, updates or removes the mod with one click."
